title: Compressor
description: Evens out loud and soft parts. Connect a sound to key to make it a sidechain compressor (the key drives the reduction).

inputs.name: region
inputs.title: Region in
inputs.description: A region (the joins of a loop) to process instead of audio. The result stays a region: it never reaches an audio input, only a region-merge block turns it back into audio.

outputs.name: region
outputs.title: Loop seam
outputs.description: The processed region. Connect it to another effect or to a region-merge block.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.doc: Off passes the sound through untouched (bypass).

parameters.name: ratio
parameters.doc: Reduction: 4 means 4 dB over the threshold becomes 1 dB.

parameters.name: keyFilter
parameters.doc: With a key input: only sound above this frequency drives the reduction (0 is off).

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both).
